Subject: Acceptance of Your Offer to Receive Our Retired Laptops  

Dear [Trader’s Name],

Thank you for your generous offer to take our 80 retired laptops (5‑8 years old, some with cracked screens) for reuse in Ghana. We are pleased to accept and appreciate the cost‑effective and timely solution you provide.

Before shipment, we will ensure that all devices have been securely data‑wiped in accordance with our internal IT‑asset disposal policy and Swiss data‑protection regulations. A certificate of data erasure will be attached to the shipping documentation for your records.

Please let us know the preferred shipping address, any required customs paperwork, and the estimated pickup date so we can coordinate the logistics. If you need any additional information (e.g., serial numbers, condition summary), feel free to ask.

Thank you again for helping us responsibly repurpose these assets. We look forward to a smooth handover.

Best regards,

[Your Full Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Swiss IT Firm Name]  
[Phone Number]  
[Email Address]
reasoning: We need to respond with a reply accepting the offer. Must be professional, perhaps mention compliance with data wiping, shipping details, gratitude. Also note any obligations: data security, maybe mention that we will wipe data before shipping. Provide contact info. Should be concise but polite. No extra commentary. Ensure we follow style: business email. Probably include subject line. Provide acceptance. Let's craft.
